planting hole noun

also pit, hole (for a plant), trench (for planting)

classical

Col. 4.1.5 (Lewis & Short)
Col. 5.5.2 (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 16.131 (Lewis & Short)

scrobis, scrobis m.

noun, third declension

a hole or trench dug for planting; a pit

Less often feminine. Also a grave.

Examples

  • scrobibus superābit terra replētīs

    when the holes are filled again there will be earth left overVerg. G. 2.235

See also dig, hole, furrow, transplant, spade.
